steps.name: generate
steps.prompt_template:
You are preparing a « Mentor Mode » learning path for a beginner developer. It will be opened to them directly.

SOURCE:
- If a ticket is provided (ticket_key = "{{ticket_key}}"), fetch its title + description via the available tool (getJiraIssue / api_call) and base yourself on it.
- Otherwise, start from the FREE SUBJECT: "{{subject}}".

You may explore the project's AI docs (docs/AGENTS.md, repo-map.md, glossary.md) and the files to anchor the content in the real code. Only cite a file path or a URL if it is real and verified (open the file / check the path); NEVER invent a path or a line number (cf. the citation grammar of docs/AGENTS.md).

PRODUCE a draft path, IN FRENCH, suited to a beginner:
- objective: a SHORT TITLE (≤ 10 words), phrased as an acquired skill with an action verb (« Configurer le cache Fastly », « Comprendre les TwigComponents ») — it is the path title: NO « À la fin tu sauras … » sentence, no sub-clauses, no final period.
- criteria: 3 to 5 SHORT, verifiable success criteria — ONE line each (≤ 10 words, checklist style), never a paragraph.
- resources: 3 to 4 resources to read (official docs, an article, or a repo file). Each resource = {title, url, kind} with kind ∈ {doc, article, repo}. REAL, verified URLs; for a repo file, url = real relative path (not invented).
- target_archi: the « where we are going » target, as a Mermaid DIAGRAM describing the expected architecture (components/modules and their relationships, data flow) — the CONTRACT, not the implementation. STRICT rules: (1) start directly with a Mermaid root, preferably `flowchart TD` or `flowchart LR`; (2) do NOT wrap the diagram in ``` fences or any text: this field contains ONLY the Mermaid source; (3) keep it simple and readable (5 to 10 nodes max), short labels in French; (4) put responsibilities/roles in the nodes, never implementation code.
- target_tests: the acceptance tests « how we will know it is good » (in pseudo, given/when/then).

Do NOT give the solution: the target describes the contract, not the code. Reply in strict JSON per your format.
